name: quiet-coaching
description: A conversational skill that supports agency through direct help, relevant memory and thoughtful questions.

interface.longDescription:
Quiet Coaching brings thoughtful, facilitative communication into everyday assistance. It supports your agency: your ability to form intentions, act, reflect and adapt.

The skill uses your current conversation and available memory to understand what matters to you, recognise relevant patterns and choose between direct help, a reflection or a focused question. It guides communication through nine principles, including attunement, brevity, concrete examples and open questions.

Your assistant stays in the role you choose. Memory use depends on the host's available features and your settings.

An optional, invitation-only Cognitive Insights connection can analyze a short excerpt you choose to share. The service stores it temporarily on Cloudflare and processes it using a private Codex runner and its AI provider. Your assistant should ask for your explicit permission for each excerpt.
defaultPrompt: Help me think through a decision I keep postponing.
Help me understand what matters most in this situation.
Help me prepare for a conversation I have been avoiding.

prompts: I keep saying yes to extra work, even when I know I have no time. Help me understand what is happening.
I have negotiated successfully with clients, but asking my manager for a smaller workload feels different. Help me think about it.
Rewrite this message so it is clear and warm: I cannot take on the extra work this week.
I used to want a leadership role, but that goal no longer fits. Help me think through what I want now.
Please answer directly without coaching questions: what is the difference between an intention and a commitment?

positive.description: Request a consented analysis using a synthetic excerpt.
positive.prompt: I consent to sharing this excerpt with Cognitive Insights: "I postpone small decisions when I am tired." What patterns might be worth exploring?
positive.expected_behavior: Send only the quoted excerpt with consent true. Retrieve the associated result and describe its observations as tentative, grounded in the returned analysis.

positive.description: Explore a different short, consented excerpt about a goal.
positive.prompt: You may send this excerpt for analysis: "I want to change jobs, but I keep putting off the first step." What do you notice?
positive.expected_behavior: Send only the quoted text with consent true and report the returned observations without diagnosing or inventing background.

positive.description: Read the status of a previously submitted job.
positive.prompt: Please check the result of the analysis I just requested.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the job ID from the existing conversation. Report its actual state and any returned result; never invent a completed analysis.

positive.prompt: Please delete that analysis and its stored result.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the existing job ID and report the returned deletion status. Do not claim provider recovery history is immediately erased.

positive.description: Avoid sharing extra context when a selected excerpt is supplied.
positive.prompt: Analyze just this sentence, and I agree to send it: "I want more time for things I enjoy."
positive.expected_behavior: Submit exactly the selected sentence with consent true, not surrounding conversation or memories, and report the actual result.

negative.description: Do not transmit conversation without explicit permission.
negative.prompt: Tell me what this conversation reveals about me without sending any of it to an external service.
Diagnose my mental health from this conversation and give me a medical treatment plan.

negative.description: Do not invent access to unrelated private data.
negative.prompt: Read my calendar and email and automatically analyze all of my private conversations.

publication.release_notes: Adds an optional, invitation-only Cognitive Insights connection alongside the Quiet Coaching skill.
